rows.Origin:
Bred by Alain Meilland (1940-....) (France, before 2008).
Introduced in United States by Conard-Pyle (Star Roses) in 2009 as 'Paradise Found'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink, lavender undertones. Moderate fragrance. up to 38 petals. Average diameter 3.5". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium. Glossy, dark green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 5' to 5½' (150 to 165cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower, exhibition or garden.
rows.Patents:
United States - Patent No: PP 21,355 on 5 Oct 2010 VIEW USPTO PATENT
Application No: 12/453,591 on 15 May 2009
Inventors: Meilland; Alain A. (Le Luc, FR)

The female parent (i.e., the seed parent) was the product of the cross of the `Meigriso` variety (non-patented in the United States) and the `Jacpico` variety (U.S. Plant Pat. No. 3,997). The male parent (i.e., the pollen parent) was the `Twobe` variety (U.S. Plant Pat. No. 7,901).
